newsitem.title: GERMANY: German beet plantings nearly complete.
newsitem.headline: German beet plantings nearly complete.

text.p: German farmers have mostly finished sugar beet sowings but recent rains in some region means work will drag on until later this week, analysts said on Monday.
"Most of our 30 regional posts report sowings are complete," an offical at the DWD national meteorological office said.
"Temperatures are too low for this time of year and look set to remain cold," he added.
The cold front had caused some minor damage to spring grains and delayed maize plantings, DWD also said.
A statement from producer Zuckerverbund Nord AG, which is located in the main northern growing state of Lower Saxony, said its overall sowings on Monday represented 70 percent of the total area.
National sugar industry association WVZ in Bonn said it would release an estimate of 1997/98 plantings either late this week or early next week.
